# Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 Part 2 release schedule

Subaru’s battle to reclaim everything he has lost is nearly back

Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- season 4 is preparing to return after leaving Subaru and his anime companions in an increasingly desperate position.

Ad
The first half of the fourth season, titled the Loss Arc, ran for 11 episodes between April and June 2026, following the group’s dangerous journey through the Auguria Sand Dunes towards the Pleiades Watchtower.

However, the season is not finished yet. Part 2, officially adapting the light novel’s Recapture Arc, will begin from a specific release date in August and take this part of the story’s remaining eight episodes.

Read on for the confirmed Re:Zero season 4 part 2 release schedule, episode count and latest streaming details.

## What time are new episodes of Re:Zero season 4 part 2 released?

Re:Zero season 4 part 2’s release date is **Wednesday 12 August 2026, which is when it begins airing in Japan — ** as confirmed by Crunchyroll in June, with each episode set to drop the same day each week.

###### More like this

#### Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World season 4 release schedule: When are new episodes on Crunchyroll?

As revealed via the anime’s official Japanese website, the earliest television broadcast is scheduled for **10pm JST on AT-X**, while episodes will air on Tokyo MX from 11pm JST. Japanese streaming service ABEMA will also carry episodes every Wednesday from 10:30pm JST.

The 10pm JST broadcast time translates to approximately:

- **2pm BST**
- **9am ET**
- **6am PT**
- **3pm CEST**
- **6:30pm IST**
- **11pm AEST**

Although Crunchyroll confirmed part 2 will start streaming on 12 August, its Summer 2026 schedule currently lists the precise international airtime as TBA. If the actual airtimes in other territories end up being significantly different to the converted JST airtimes, we’ll update this guide right away.

## Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- season 4 part 2 release schedule

After its 12 August premiere date, if following a date weekly rollout, the full release schedule for Re:Zero season 4 part 2 should look as follows:

- **Part 2 episode 1 (season 4 episode 12): Wednesday 12 August 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 2 (season 4 episode 13): Wednesday 19 August 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 3 (season 4 episode 14): Wednesday 26 August 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 4 (season 4 episode 15): Wednesday 2 September 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 5 (season 4 episode 16): Wednesday 9 September 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 6 (season 4 episode 17): Wednesday 16 September 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 7 (season 4 episode 18): Wednesday 23 September 2026**
- **Part 2 episode 8 (season 4 episode 19): Wednesday 30 September 2026**

However, this is provided there are no unexpected delays or breaks. Just like with the release times, we’ll adjust this schedule if there happen to be any changes to any episode’s release date.

## How many episodes are there in Re:Zero season 4 part 2?

Re:ZERO season 4 part 2 is set to have **eight episodes**, which was also confirmed via the anime’s official Japanese website.

With the Loss Arc containing 11 episodes, this will bring season 4’s overall total to **19 episodes** across its two parts. Assuming the weekly schedule continues without interruption, the season 4 finale should therefore air on **Wednesday 30 September 2026**.

The Recapture Arc will continue the struggle surrounding the Pleiades Watchtower, as Subaru attempts to recover what has been taken from him and his allies. Following the effects of Gluttony’s Authority, Rem remains asleep, Crusch has lost her memories, and Julius has had his name erased from the world.

## Where can I watch Re:Zero season 4 part 2?

In the UK and US, Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- season 4 part 2 will be available to stream on **Crunchyroll**.

The platform has included the Recapture Arc in its Summer 2026 line-up, and the first three seasons and the completed Loss Arc are also available through the streaming service, giving viewers time to catch up before Subaru’s story resumes.

## Re:Zero season 4 part 2 trailer

#### Want to see this content?

A separate full-length trailer devoted entirely to the Recapture Arc has not yet been released, but the main season 4 trailer is available to watch now.

Meanwhile, the conclusion of the Loss Arc was followed by a new Recapture Arc visual and a special music video featuring Rie Takahashi’s new performance of **Stay Alive ~Regain~**, also shown off in Crunchyroll's news post for part 2.

Ad**Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- season 4 part 2 begins on Crunchyroll on Wednesday 12 August 2026.**

sources.content:
Meanwhile, some of the biggest series of the summer continue to build momentum. ** pushes its third season into a new stretch, Jobless Reincarnation**

**continues delivering its signature over-the-top romantic comedy, and much, much more. From fantasy epics and supernatural thrillers to heartfelt romances, August is sure to offer something interesting for any kind of anime fan. Whether you're keeping up with the season week by week or looking for your next obsession,** *The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You* **these are the biggest new and continuing anime series to stream this month**.

## 'Re:ZERO - Starting Life in Another World' Season 4 Part 2

**Release Date: ** August 12 | **Studio:** White Fox | **Streamer:** Crunchyroll

 Remove Ads**Cast:** Kazuya Kamenashi, Takuya Satou, Maaya Uchida.

To reach the Pleiades Watchtower, Subaru and his friends must cross the deadly Auguria Dunes, an unforgiving desert filled with monstrous creatures and other dangers that hide in every corner. With **higher stakes than ever and another mystery waiting to be unraveled**, Season 4 Part 2 looks set to deliver the suspense, heartbreak, and unforgettable twists that have made the series a fan favorite for nearly a decade.

## 'Link Click' Season 3

**Release Date: ** August 14 | **Studio: ** BeDream | **Streamer: ** Crunchyroll

**Cast: ** Toshiyuki Toyonaga, Takahiro Sakurai, Aoi Koga, Ami Koshimizu.

Returning for its highly anticipated third season,** follows Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two friends who use extraordinary powers to Link Click**

**enter photographs and relive the moments captured within them**. Operating out of the unassuming Time Photo Studio, they help clients uncover the truth behind precious memories, solve lingering mysteries, and grant final wishes. But every mission comes with enormous risks, as even the smallest decision in the past can have devastating consequences.

## 'The Ribbon Hero'

**Release Date: ** August 8 | **Studio:** Outline | **Streamer: ** Netflix

Cast: Toshiyuki Toyonaga, Takahiro Sakurai, Aoi Koga, Ami Koshimizu.

If you're searching for your next fantasy adventure, *The Ribbon Hero* should be your next watch. Netflix's newest anime follows Sapphire, the princess of the fallen kingdom of **Silverland, which was destroyed by a calamity known as Nergal**. After losing everything she loved, Sapphire finds refuge in the neighboring kingdom of Goldland, where the compassion of its people slowly begins to heal her shattered spirit.

Just as she starts to believe she can leave the past behind, the same evil that destroyed her home resurfaces, threatening to ruin her newfound home. Refusing to let history repeat itself, Sapphire takes up her sword and vows to protect the people who gave her a second chance. As she confronts the mysterious calamity head-on, **Sapphire will have to overcome her grief, embrace her destiny**, and discover what it truly means to be a hero.

## 'Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation' Season 3

Episodes 6-10

Remove Ads
**Cast:** Yumi Uchiyama, Konomi Kohara, Ai Kakuma, Ai Kayano.

*Jobless Reincarnation* continues its third season with another slate of highly anticipated episodes. The series follows Rudeus Greyrat, a 34-year-old shut-in who is given a second chance after dying in a traffic accident and being reborn in a magical world of sorcery and mythical creatures.

Determined not to repeat the mistakes of his previous life, Rudeus dedicates himself to becoming a better person, growing from a gifted mage into one of the world's most formidable adventurers. **The latest round of episodes continues Rudeus' journey** as he faces powerful adversaries that threaten the peace he's worked so hard to build.

## 'Grand Blue Dreaming' Season 3

### Episodes 5-8

**Release Date: ** July 6 | **Studio:** Zero-G | **Streamer:** Crunchyroll

 Remove Ads**Cast: ** Yuuma Uchida, Chika Anzai, Ryouhei Kimura, Kana Asumi.

**This season takes the adventure beyond Japan** as Iori heads to the tropical paradise of Palau to help his cousin open a new dive shop. Between underwater excursions and the return of his hilariously unpredictable friends, what should be a relaxing getaway quickly turns into another string of misadventures.

## 'The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You' Season 3

### Episodes 5-9

**Release Date: ** July 5 | **Studio: ** Bibury Animation Studios | **Streamer: ** Crunchyroll

**Cast: ** Miyu Tomita, Wataru Katou, Maria Naganawa, Asami Seto, Kaede Hondo.

If over-the-top romantic comedies are more your speed, it doesn't get much wilder than* The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You.* The series follows Rentaro Aijo, an unlucky teen who suffers 100 straight rejections before learning he's destined to meet 100 soulmates in high school, but if any of those destined relationships fail, the rejected soulmate will die. Faced with an impossible situation, Rentaro sets out to make every one of his girlfriends feel equally loved, no matter how difficult that may be.

## 'Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun' Season 4

### Episodes 16-22

**Release Date: ** April 4 | **Studio: ** Bandai Namco Pictures | **Streamer: ** Crunchyroll

**Cast: ** Ayumu Murase, Ayaka Asai, Ryouhei Kimura.

** follows Suzuki Iruma, an ordinary human whose irresponsible parents sell him to the powerful demon Sullivan. Rather than becoming a meal, Iruma is adopted as Sullivan's beloved grandson and enrolled at the prestigious Babyls Demon School, where he must keep his human identity a secret while trying to survive life among demons. Through kindness, determination, and a knack for winning people over, Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun**

**Iruma gradually rises through the demon ranks** despite wanting nothing more than an ordinary life.

The latest episodes **center on the highly anticipated Music Festival**, where Iruma and the Misfit Class are tasked with an almost impossible challenge: every member must reach Rank 4, a feat that can only be accomplished by winning the competition. As the class prepares for the biggest performance of their lives, friendships are tested, confidence is shaken, and each student must learn how to stand out without losing sight of what makes them unique.

sources.title: TV anime "Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky"
sources.content:
## INTRODUCTION

The 15th GA Bunko Award Grand Prize Winner

Ranked #3 in the General New Titles category of Takarajimasha's “Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! 2024” (lit. This Light Novel is Amazing)
One spring night, Kakeru Sorano, a university freshman, is dragged by his dormmate Narumi to a welcome party.

There, he meets Koharu Fuyutsuki, a blind girl who laughs often and speaks of her dreams; she’s practically the polar opposite of him.

From the moment he picks up her white cane after class, the distance between them begins to shrink.
“I want to see fireworks,”

she says one day. Those words carry a light that Kakeru gazes at directly for the first time.
A girl who cannot see and a boy who has shut himself off

this is a delicate love story woven by two people searching for light.

sources.content:
The fifth weekly poll for the Summer 2026 anime season has concluded, and *Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia* has returned to the top of the rankings. After finishing fifth last week, the series climbed four spots to take first place with 6.75% of the vote.

*Though I Am an Inept Villainess* followed closely behind with 6.32%, holding onto a top-three spot for the fourth consecutive week. Last week’s winner, *Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity*, dropped to third with 6.26%, just 0.06 percentage points behind second place.

*Saga of Tanya the Evil II* remained in fourth, while *Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3* rounded out the top five.

As always, these rankings reflect the preferences of the Anime Corner community and are not intended to determine what anyone should or should not watch. Every anime has its own appeal, so we encourage readers to give any series that catches their interest a chance before voting in future weekly polls.
